name: vibe-techdesign
title_zh: 把 MVP 技术选型变成一张可执行的架构设计图
tagline_zh: 还在为技术栈纠结到深夜？给它一句「帮我规划技术设计」，它直接产出架构图、数据流和依赖清单，连迁移路径都替你标好。
tagline_en: Stop agonizing over stacks at 2 AM. Say "plan technical design" and get architecture, data flow, and dependency.
desc_en: Create a Technical Design Document for your MVP. Use when the user wants to plan architecture, choose tech stack, or says "plan technical design", "choose tech stack", or "how should I build this".
why_zh: 它不写代码，而是把需求翻译成决策树：每个选型都带权衡说明，让你在动手前看清所有岔路，而不是闷头踩坑。
why_en: It doesn't code—it translates requirements into a decision tree, weighing each option so you see every fork before you commit.
limit_zh: 只服务 MVP 阶段，不覆盖已有系统的重构或微服务拆分；产物是设计文档，不含代码骨架；需要你提供业务约束。
limit_en: MVP only—no refactoring or microservice splits. Output is a design doc, not code. Needs your business constraints; otherwise defaults to the leanest.
